description: Create a thread (multiple connected posts published as a chain). Use the platforms parameter to post the same thread to X, Bluesky and LinkedIn in one call. LinkedIn has no threads, so it gets the whole thread as one post. Omitting platforms leaves the targeting to the account auto cross-post setting rather than pinning the thread to X.

auto_retweet.description: Enable auto-retweet after posting. X only, ignored on Bluesky and LinkedIn.

auto_retweet_offset_minutes.description: Minutes to wait before auto-retweeting (e.g. 60, 120, 240). Defaults to 60.

platforms.description: Networks to post to: "x", "bluesky", "linkedin". Pass ["x", "bluesky", "linkedin"] to publish the same content to all three in one call. Any non-empty subset works, so ["linkedin"] posts to LinkedIn only, and an explicit list is always honoured exactly. LinkedIn posts go to the connected personal profile, and a thread goes to LinkedIn as one combined post. Leaving this out is not the same as pinning to X: an unspecified post follows the account auto cross-post setting, which sends it to every connected network when that setting is on. Call opentweet_list_platforms to see what an unspecified post would target. A network the user has not connected is reported as skipped rather than failing the call.

publish_now.description: Set to true to publish immediately

scheduled_date.description: ISO 8601 date-time to schedule. Omit to save as draft.

tweets.description: Array of post texts in order (max 280 chars each for free X accounts, up to 25,000 for Premium+; Bluesky caps at 300 characters per post; on LinkedIn the parts are joined into one post of up to 3,000 characters)

x_account_id.description: Target X account ID (for multi-account users). Omit to use primary account.

name: opentweet_create_thread
